justification: src/main.tsx is Vite's client-only browser entry point (the separate src/entry-server.tsx is the SSR entry) - it structurally never executes during SSR/SSG, so its module-top-level document.getElementById('root') is not an SSR-hydration risk.

rollup-plugin-visualizer's own types import Plugin from "rollup", which Vite 8 no longer depends on directly (it moved to rolldown), so that import resolves to any. The runtime value returned by visualizer() is a legitimate Vite plugin object; casting it to Vite's own Plugin type bridges a real upstream type-resolution gap and is type-only - there is no runtime value to type-guard against since the shape is already correct.
